Subject: Update on Your Department Budget Request

Dear [Name],

Thank you for submitting your request for a budget increase for your department. After careful review, we are unable to approve the request at this time, as the current justification does not align with the company's ongoing financial strategy.

However, we encourage you to resubmit your proposal. To strengthen your case, please include a more detailed explanation along with concrete examples of the anticipated benefits. This additional context will help us better evaluate the potential impact and value of your request.

Please let me know if you have any questions or need further clarification.

Best regards,

[Your Name]

The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.
